On The File Of This Hon'Ble Court And Grant Such
Other And Further Reliefs As Are Just.

This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

1. The land measuring 3 Acres 21 Guntas in Survey No.3/1A of Giriyanahalli Village, Bellavi Hobli,
Tumkur NC: 2024:KHC:1012 Taluk has been acquired for the purpose of respondent No.3.

2. Respondent No.1 filed Writ Petition No.50235/2019(LA-KIADB), wherein this Court has set aside the General Award and has directed the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board (for short,
the 'KIADB') to consider the case of respondent No.1 under Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 (for short, the 'KIAD Act').
3. Aggrieved by the same, the petitioner has filed the present Review Petition.

4. The case of the petitioner is that respondent No.1 is not the owner of the property and the petitioner is the owner of the property and respondent No.1 has in fact tampered with the land records pertaining to the property concerned and he is trying to illegally take the compensation awarded.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, respondent No.1 submits that he is the owner of the property concerned and the petitioner has no rights whatsoever in respect of the same.

6. Learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.2 to 4, upon instructions, submits that as there was a dispute as to who is the owner of the property concerned, LAC No.9/2021 has been registered before the Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM at Tumkur, which is the jurisdictional Reference Court and both the petitioner and respondent No.1 are parties to the proceedings over there and the person who succeeds in the said proceedings will be granted the compensation.

It is further submitted that, in view of the decision rendered in WP No.50235/2019, the KIADB had preferred an application before the Reference Court with the following prayer;
 "That for the reasons stated in the  accompanying affidavit and in the circumstances of the case, it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to NC:
2024:KHC:1012 advance the case to release the entire FD of Rs.14,20,754/- which is deposited by the Spl LAO, KIADB/petitioner, with accrued interest in the above case in the interest of justice and equity."
and that the said application has not been pressed by the KIADB in the light of the subsequent developments and filing of this Review Petition.
7.
Admittedly, there is a dispute as to who is the owner of the property concerned.
This Court cannot decide the same in exercise of its power under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, as it involves disputed questions of fact.
It is the responsibility of the Reference Court to adjudicate as to the same.

8. Further, the impugned order in WP No.50235/2019 does not direct the KIADB to pay compensation to respondent No.1 herein, it has directed to the KIADB to consider the case of respondent No.1 in accordance with law in terms of Section 29(2) of the KIADB Act.

No errors NC:
2024:KHC:1012 can be found in the said order.

Further as the matter is now pending before the Reference Court, which is going to decide as to who is the owner of the property and who is entitled for the compensation, no injustice will be caused to the petitioner herein due to the passing of the impugned order.
9. For the aforementioned reasons, the Review Petition is hereby dismissed, subject to the above aforementioned observations.
